problem: Current ProductWarehouseStockPage.total counts warehouse×SKU identities; page rows cannot establish warehouse aggregate, whole-product total, or NON_ZERO warehouse filter. Existing ProductDetailsPageQuery has only productId/page/pageSize.

evidence.usedFor: Read-only stockBody UI behavior: sum all SKU per warehouse, filter warehouse quantity!==0 unless stockAll; global product total separate from visible warehouses.

decision: Add one bounded whole-warehouse overview query alongside existing warehouse×SKU page. Reuse actual inventory scope, publication/admission and sparse balance semantics; no persistent schema field or alternate inventory engine.

api.owner: D2 owns shared product detail DTO/validation/service/HTTP; C freezes public contract before wiring
requestRules: Both fields required; no client warehouse list, count, label, ready flag, snapshot or fallback. Unknown properties rejected.
NON_ZERO is warehouse net quantity !=0, retaining negative and UNKNOWN warehouses. It is not positive-only or SKU-level existence.
ALL includes every currently authorized retained warehouse, including disabled/history-retained warehouses, subject to original current inventory policy.
Overview is complete bounded warehouse aggregation, no page/pageSize. At most1000 authorized warehouses, matching existing policy bound. Overflow rejects whole query, never truncates.

response.readReference: new opaque nonsecret per-read random reference

total.quantity: canonical exact signed integer string when KNOWN, null otherwise

response.items: Full post-mode array in authoritative warehouse order; each {warehouseId,warehouseName,state:KNOWN|UNKNOWN,quantity:string|null,unknownSkuCount:number}

totalRules: total always covers ALL authorized warehouses and ALL native product SKU identities before display-mode filtering. NON_ZERO/ALL does not redefine the total.
counts.authorizedWarehouses = nonZeroWarehouses + zeroWarehouses + unknownWarehouses; returned=authorized forALL, nonZero+unknown forNON_ZERO. items.length mustequalreturned.

All quantities exact decimal integer strings; underlying cell uses signed bigint constraints, aggregates may exceed a single-cell bigint so use PostgreSQL numeric/BigInt and existing up-to100char aggregate validation. Never JavaScript Number summation.
If any unadmitted original key remains UNKNOWN, its warehouse quantity=null/stateUNKNOWN; product total=null/stateUNKNOWN, count all unknown keys. Do not display partial known subtotal as total.
An ALL empty array is not a no-warehouse success: current no authorized scope returns403. NON_ZERO empty is valid only wholeauthorized quantities are KNOWN zero.
api.compatibility: Existing POST /products/stock/query and ProductWarehouseStockPage.total keep warehouse×SKU row semantics. No overloaded total or silent body shape change. Old full product detail validators remain intact until D2 adds separate overview parser/response validator.

authorization: Real session/current account first; existing product stock-tab grant separately required. New overview intent is explicitly routed by D2 to the existing stock-tab permission, not inferred from basic product visibility or client productId.

D3 calls actual InventoryQueryAuthorization with native product filter and obtains finite current hallIds/warehouses. Hall AND warehouse intersection applies before ANY stock count/aggregate; no admin/empty-array global shortcut.

Existing createSourceConfirmedPostgresReadAuthorization currently grants inventory reads all native warehouses to authorizedADMIN/WAREHOUSE/SALESPERSON, validates current account/staff/hall and retains disabled warehouse/hall records. Reuse this behavior, do not infer it from role alone.

Within the same inventory read snapshot independently verify exact authorized IDs/halls/labels and prove full-native-warehouse coverage using a boolean NOT EXISTS comparison. Only then coverage=ALL_BUSINESS_WAREHOUSES. Otherwise AUTHORIZED_SUBSET; never return hidden warehouse IDs/names/quantities/counts.
F2 uses总库存 only forALL_BUSINESS_WAREHOUSES; AUTHORIZED_SUBSET uses授权范围合计 and说明. This flag is reader-produced proof, not an expansion of permissions.
sparseAndUnknown: Native product exists and all intended actual SKU identities belong to its size-group memberships. SKU universe comes from sku.product_id, not balance presence, selected visible specs, barcode joins or season-array expansion. Retained historical SKU identities stay included.
Full product with no trustworthy SKU set/invalid native size membership is NOT_READY/integrity error, not fabricated zero. Unsaved new product remains save-first UI and sends no query.

For each actual authorized warehouse×SKU key: exact19 published warehouse+SKU membership OR D1-issued exact26 central inventory_key_admission decision. Constructor/runtime must explicitly support26 with same-client assertReady(INVENTORY_ADMISSION). Existing23/24 union is not26 authority.
Admitted key with valid balance+ledger -> signed actual quantity includingnegative/zero. Admitted key absent balance AND absent ledger -> exactzero; never insert zero balance.

Unadmitted key -> UNKNOWN/null even when absence exists. Missing balance with ledger, malformed balance/version/lastoperation, invalid references or failed SQL -> whole-read error, neverzero/partial cached success.
No synthetic nonexistent color/fit/size combinations; not-applicable matrix positions are not SKU identities and contribute neitherzero norunknown.
